//: Package Configuration for @mbe/scripts. Its suite is a repo-audit suite: many tests read files OUTSIDE scripts/ (workflow guards read .github/workflows/**, the visual-tolerance guards read apps/rialto-web/playwright.config.ts and e2e/**, hook tests execute .claude/hooks/** against .claude/settings.json, phantom-tokens walks apps/** and packages/rialto/src/**, workspace-coverage reads every package.json, vitest-workspace-coverage walks for vitest.config.*). Root turbo.json's task inputs hash none of those, so a mutation that breaks a guard left the task hash byte-identical and a cache hit could skip the red run (docs/backlog.md seed, from maintenance:visual-tolerance-threshold). These inputs over-approximate on purpose: an extra cache miss is noise, a false cache hit silently skips a guard. Enforced end-to-end by scripts/__tests__/turbo-task-inputs.test.mjs, which mutates a watched file and asserts the dry-run hash moves. If a new test reads a path no glob below covers, add the glob here.
